craft_notes: Sthāyin: sun-in-water (no bondage, no freedom: terrors are reflections — frightened's terrors, intellect in waters, sun's). Rows: row 2 (terrors→reflection). Close: sun's (the possessive closes: sūryasya — the sun OWNS the reflection; source, not image, lands last). Rejected: 'neither bound nor free' smoothed — killed: not-of-me kept (mama as the verse's anchor: bondage is FIRST-PERSON denied); 'mirage' — killed: reflection-in-waters kept (pratibimba precise: intellect mirrored, sun real).

lines: Not of me bondage, not freedom — frightened's terrors:
this reflection of intellect in waters, sun's.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na me bandho na mokṣo me bhītasyaitā vibhīṣikāḥ | pratibimbam idam buddher jaleṣv iva vivasvataḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is bondage here? → No bondage, no freedom — terrors are mere reflections, sun-in-water.
c1_essence: No bondage, no freedom: terrors reflections in water.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness that ends in sovereignty)
